div.div:
Flow — 1 request + access token · 2 the edge passes verified claims only · 3 tenant exists and ENABLED? · 4 trusted tenant context created · 5 context to the gateway (ask) or the ingestion service (upload) · 6 retrieve WITH owning_tenant EQUALS tenant_id · 7 tenant-scoped results · 8 verify owner + AVAILABLE against ownership records · 9 verified context only to the model
Ingestion — the service writes the ownership record, stores the original at the derived location and indexes with the owner attribute it supplies · ✕ caller-controlled values and document content are never a source of tenant or ownership · dashed grey: privileged operator path, recorded
